stories.title: Senedd Member backs campaign for Holywell banking hub after Santander closure left town with no bank
stories.summary: Clwyd Member of the Senedd Darren Millar is calling on LINK to carry out a new assessment of Holywell’s banking needs after the town lost its last bank. He is backing a campaign for a banking hub, a shared branch where customers of different banks can get face-to-face help, to be set up in Holywell.

stories.title: North Wales Police warns GTA VI players there is “no respawn” in real life
stories.summary: North Wales Police has used the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI to remind gamers there is no respawn in real life. It goes on sale today, Thursday 19 November. stories.title: Fourteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Mold worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Mold face five sets of roadworks today, with Llys Nercwys closed until Wednesday 2 December.

stories.title: Update: Power restored in Flint says SP Energy Networks
stories.summary: Part of Flint is without power tonight after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 2.24am tomorrow.

stories.title: Flintshire council still waiting for legal advice on its own rule changes
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is still waiting for legal advice on whether changes it made to its own rulebook last month were lawful, councillors have been told. The council’s monitoring officer, who advises on legal and constitutional matters, said on Tuesday that he had still not received independent legal advice on the changes, despite chasing it.
